research_slices.title: Recover the provenance of the original Part B thirty-item list
research_slices.trigger: Proceed if the original intake/source record becomes accessible; otherwise complete a bounded source scan and report an unrecovered result without reconstructing a fictional original list.
research_slices.goal: Determine whether the original thirty Part B candidate boundaries can be recovered from an authoritative source, separately from the current statement-derived reconstruction.
research_slices.enables: A provenance-backed comparison or an explicit unrecovered disposition that prevents the reconstruction from being mislabeled as the original list.

oracle.expected: Either 30 unique source-backed original records, or status unrecovered with a completed bounded search log and no fabricated item list.
oracle.verifier: The standard-library artifact validator checks status-dependent shape, uniqueness, search log presence, and source references.

research_slices.rollback: Remove only the provenance report; never replace it with inferred titles or treat the statement-derived reconstruction as recovered source.
research_evidence: authoritative source records searched by the research owner
